name: "The Lethal Injection" Darren Scott
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 3 February 1999, titled "(Roleplay) Critique [Las]", served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/roleplay-critique-las-1999-02-03.html. On a bench in a park in Phoenix, Arizona, the bleached-blond Darren Scott in a "I'm Too Damn Lethal" shirt says he was turned down by the WCWA and the INWI and turned to the IMWA, where Ian Walsh treated him like a man after the IMWA Training Facility, and promises his opponent he will win his debut at the IMWA's first card on Saturday in Topeka, Kansas.
caption: A bleached-blond rookie who says only the IMWA believed in him, promising to win his debut at its first card in February 1999.

tenures.source: /promotions/rspwf/archive/roleplay-critique-las-1999-02-03.html (his debut promo for the IMWA's first card, the coming Saturday in Topeka, Kansas); the promotion's own IMWA Preview of 2 February 1999 (/promotions/imwa-1999/archive/imwa-preview-1999-02-03.html) bills "The Lethal Injection" Darren Scott on that first card, Zero Hour (6 February 1999), as a graduate of the IMWA Training Camp
